results.question: How much did I spend on groceries in March 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'groceries' AND substr(t.posted_date,1,7) = '2026-03'

results.question: What was my total spending in January 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND substr(posted_date,1,7) = '2026-01'

results.question: How many transactions do I have in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM transactions

results.question: What was my single largest purchase?
results.sql: SELECT raw_descriptor FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' ORDER BY amount ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: How much did I spend on coffee over the whole period?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'coffee' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How many times did I buy coffee?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions AS t JOIN categories AS c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'coffee' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: What is my average grocery transaction?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'groceries' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much total income did I receive?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'income'

results.question: How much did I pay in bank fees?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'fees') AND type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much did I spend on rent in total?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'rent') AND type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much did I spend between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date >= '2026-01-01' AND posted_date <= '2026-03-31'

results.question: What did I spend in the last three months of the data?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date >= '2026-05-01'

results.question: How much did I spend on dining in the second half of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'dining' AND substr(t.posted_date, 1, 7) >= '2025-07' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: What is the date of my earliest transaction?
results.sql: SELECT MIN(posted_date) FROM transactions

results.question: What is the date of my most recent transaction?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(posted_date) FROM transactions

results.question: How much did I spend on travel in April 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'travel') AND substr(posted_date,1,7) = '2026-04'

results.question: How many months of data do I have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT substr(posted_date,1,7)) FROM transactions

results.question: How much did I spend in December 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND substr(posted_date,1,7) = '2025-12'

results.question: Did I spend more on groceries or dining overall?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = 'groceries' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = 'dining' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN 'dining' ELSE 'groceries' END FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much more did I spend in April 2026 than in March 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date,1,7) = '2026-04' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date,1,7) = '2026-03' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: Which month had the highest total spending?
results.sql: SELECT substr(posted_date,1,7) AS month FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' GROUP BY month ORDER BY SUM(amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which category do I spend the most on?
results.sql: SELECT c.name FROM categories c JOIN transactions t ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.type = 'purchase' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which merchant did I spend the most money at?
results.sql: SELECT M.canonical_name FROM merchants M JOIN transactions T ON M.id = T.merchant_id WHERE T.type = 'purchase' GROUP BY M.canonical_name ORDER BY SUM(T.amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which merchant do I visit most often?
results.sql: SELECT M.canonical_name FROM merchants M JOIN transactions T ON M.id = T.merchant_id GROUP BY M.canonical_name ORDER BY COUNT(T.id) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Was my spending in the first six months higher than the last six?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date, 1, 7) < '2026-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date, 1, 7) >= '2026-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much less did I spend on dining than on groceries?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = 'dining' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = 'groceries' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much did I spend at Amazon?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.canonical_name = 'Amazon' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How many times did I shop at Target?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM transactions WHERE merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Target')

results.question: How much do I pay Netflix each month?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.canonical_name = 'Netflix' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How many distinct merchants have I bought from?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: What did I spend at Whole Foods?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.canonical_name = 'Whole Foods' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much did I spend on Uber rides?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id WHERE t.type = 'purchase' AND m.canonical_name = 'Uber'

results.question: How many recurring charges do I have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM recurring_series WHERE active = 1

results.question: Did any of my subscriptions go up in price?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN typical_amount < last_amount THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS price_increase FROM recurring_series WHERE merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE default_category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'subscriptions')) AND active = 1 AND typical_amount < last_amount

results.question: What is my most expensive recurring charge?
results.sql: SELECT merchants.canonical_name FROM merchants JOIN recurring_series ON merchants.id = recurring_series.merchant_id ORDER BY recurring_series.typical_amount DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How much do my subscriptions cost me per month in total?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'subscriptions' AND type = 'purchase' AND substr(t.posted_date,1,7) = '2026-07'

results.question: Is my travel spending unusual in any month?
results.sql: SELECT substr(posted_date,1,7) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'travel') GROUP BY substr(posted_date,1,7) HAVING AVG(amount) < (SELECT AVG(amount) * 0.5 FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'travel'))

results.question: When did I first shop at Peloton?
results.sql: SELECT MIN(posted_date) FROM transactions WHERE merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Peloton')

results.question: What percentage of my spending was on essentials?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_essential = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: In my highest-spending month, which category dominated?
results.sql: SELECT T2.name FROM transactions AS T1 INNER JOIN categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE substr(T1.posted_date, 1, 7) = (SELECT substr(posted_date, 1, 7) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' GROUP BY substr(posted_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(amount) ASC LIMIT 1) AND T1.type = 'purchase' GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is my average monthly spending?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.amount) AS average_monthly_spending FROM transactions AS T1 WHERE T1.type = 'purchase' AND T1.posted_date >= '2025-08-01' AND T1.posted_date <= '2026-07-31'

results.question: How much did I save, counting income minus spending?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'purchase' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS savings FROM transactions

results.question: What percentage of my grocery spending went to Trader Joe's?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Trader Joe') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'groceries' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: What did I spend on anything medical-looking?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'health'

results.question: How much went on entertainment and going out?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name IN ('entertainment', 'dining') AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: What did my trips cost me?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'travel') AND type = 'purchase'
